subtitle: Lesson 4 · The Weekly Sales & Fulfillment Report

code:
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_CarrawayWeeklySalesFact AS
SELECT soh.SalesOrderID, soh.OrderDate, soh.DueDate,
       soh.ShipDate, soh.TerritoryID, sod.ProductID,
       sod.OrderQty, sod.UnitPrice, sod.LineTotal
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
WHERE soh.Status = 5;
caption: TerritoryID and ProductID only — names live in the dimension views below.

code:
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_CarrawayProductDim AS
SELECT p.ProductID, p.Name AS ProductName,
       psc.Name AS SubcategoryName
FROM Production.Product AS p
LEFT JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory AS psc
    ON psc.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID;

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_CarrawayTerritoryDim AS
SELECT TerritoryID, Name AS TerritoryName,
       [Group] AS TerritoryGroup
FROM Sales.SalesTerritory;
caption: Small, focused views — exactly the names each dimension needs.
